![](LauriTurkia.jpg){width=200px}

I am a third-year PhD student at Tampere University, affiliated with the
Finnish Centre of Excellence in Tax Systems Research (FIT) and the Education
for the Future Flagship (EDUCA), under the supervision of
prof. [Jarkko Harju](https://sites.google.com/view/jarkkoharju/home) and
assistant prof. [Vesa-Matti Heikkuri](https://www.vesamattiheikkuri.com).

My research is in labor economics, focusing on education, intergenerational
mobility, and inequality.

During the 2026-2027 academic year I am visiting
[Opportunity Insights](https://opportunityinsights.org/) at Harvard University,
hosted by prof. [Raj Chetty](https://rajchetty.com/).
